newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom lifts Lisbon shares.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom lifts Lisbon shares.

text.p: 1750 GMT - Interest in Portugal Telecom and Banco Comercial Portugues gave a boost to the indices in an otherwise lacklustre session with overall volume just 3.6 billion escudos.
*Market was helped by the strength of Wall Street and other European bourses.
*Both PT and BCP hit highs for the year but even here volumes were not large. Traders said that much of the buying of BCP was done by a brokerage within the group.
*Dealers said that the tone was likely to remain positive on Tuesday providing that Wall Street closed in positive territory, with interest once again focused on PT.

*The telecommunications company closed at 6,398 escudos, a shade below an all-time high of 6,400 escudos with investors betting on a good set of figures when the company issues its 1996 results on Wednesday.
*The PSI-20 .PSI20 index ended 0.53 percent higher at 6,210.59, with futures up 36 at 6,197.
